brief: A closed electronics enclosure with a louvred vent so the board inside can breathe.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Single hex cell (piece:0,0,0;full) capped on all 6 side faces (caps) and top face (cover:0,0,0;full;top) forming a fully enclosed box.

requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe
requirements.evidence: Port louvre (port:0#0,0#0, hex-port-louvre) fitted to one side slot; designed to vent a closed cell while keeping rain out.

finish.summary: Built a sealed single-cell enclosure with solid top cover and 6 solid side caps, with one hex-port-louvre installed for ventilation. Props (bench PSU, multimeter, cable coil) staged on bench to indicate electronics use. Joints locked.

events.text: Building your vented enclosure for the board — closed and breathing.
